sentence: I read your sketch as: a sign-in form card is sketched: a heading "Sign in", a subheading, labeled email and password inputs, a filled blue "Sign in" button, and a blue "Forgot your password?" link, all on a light gray page background. But I couldn't add what you drew. Also, one of your marks didn't match anything on the page, so I skipped it. Undo puts your files back the way they were.
